evidence.title: OpenAI新Sol「6.1」発表 Astraに迫る性能を5分の1価格で提供
evidence.body: [e005:f01] エージェント型コーディングやコンピューター操作、専門業務を強化し、標準API料金はGPT-6 Astraの5分の1に設定し、高性能モデルの大規模運用をしやすくする料金設定となった。 [e005:f02] GPT-6.1 Sol、性能とコスト効率を大幅改善 2026年9月29日に発表されたGPT-6.1 SolはGPT-6 Solのアップグレード版で、複雑な専門業務からエージェント処理まで幅広く性能を引き上げたモデルだ。 [e005:f03] コーディング評価のDeepSWE v1.1では、Astraと同等の性能を達成し、従来のGPT-6 Solの最高スコアを6.4ポイント上回った。 [e005:f04] コンピューター操作のOSWorld 2.0でも、最大思考量の設定で従来モデルを7ポイント上回り、Astraとの差を2.1ポイントまで縮めている。 [e005:f05] 科学研究向けのTerminal-Bench Science 0.1では、GPT-6 Solの2倍超のスコアを半分未満のコストで記録した。 [e005:f06] 事実誤認率も、思考量『超高』の場合は、難しいプロンプトを用いた評価で4.5%から4.1%へ低下し、Astraの4.0%に近づいたという。 [e005:f07] 標準API料金は100万トークンあたり入力2ドル、出力10ドル、キャッシュ済み入力(※)0.10ドルとなる。 [e005:f08] 提供はPlus、Pro、Business、Enterprise、Edu向けのChatGPT WorkとCodexで開始され、通常のChatではまだ利用できない。 [e005:f09] APIでは「gpt-6.1-sol」として提供される。 [e005:f10] ※キャッシュ済み入力：過去のリクエストで処理した共通の入力内容を再利用する仕組み。 [e005:f11] 高性能AIのコストパフォーマンス向上 用途別の使い分け進む 最大の利点は、最上位モデルに近い能力を、より低い単価で継続利用できる点にある。 [e005:f12] 特にコード生成や資料解析、複数ツールを使う業務エージェントでは、1回の性能だけでなく、反復実行にかかる総コストが導入可否を左右する。 [e005:f13] GPT-6.1 Solは、こうした大量運用で性能と費用の両立を狙う選択肢になりそうだ。 [e005:f14] 一方、OpenAI自身も総合能力ではGPT-6 Astraを最高モデルと位置付けているとおり、今回の更新は最高性能の更新ではない。 [e005:f15] Terminal-Bench Science 0.1でもAstraが68.1%で最高スコアを維持しており、最難関の科学研究などでは上位モデルとの差が残る。 [e005:f16] 今後はAIモデルのコストパフォーマンスの競争にも注目が必要だ。

evidence.title: OpenAI IPO Date: Investor Timeline, Valuation and Expectations
evidence.body: [e003:f01] OpenAI has been making noise with both its LLM and its potential IPO. [e003:f02] OpenAI has formally started the IPO process, but investors still don’t have an official OpenAI IPO date. [e003:f03] What We Know About OpenAI’s Current Status and IPO Plans OpenAI was founded as a nonprofit in 2015. [e003:f04] Bottom Line OpenAI confidentially submitted its S-1 on June 8, 2026, but it has not announced an official IPO date. [e003:f05] 2 That tension between rapid growth and extraordinary spending may ultimately matter more to investors than the exact IPO date. [e003:f06] Expected Valuation and What Investors Would Be Paying OpenAI’s valuation has risen far beyond the $80 billion level cited in earlier funding rounds. [e003:f07] In March 2026, OpenAI raised $122 billion at an $852 billion post-money valuation. [e003:f08] Using that figure, here’s what several hypothetical revenue multiples would imply: Revenue Multiple Implied Valuation 15x $600 billion 20x $800 billion 25x $1.0 trillion 30x $1.2 trillion These aren’t IPO price targets. [e003:f09] The remaining process could include SEC comments and revisions, publication of a registration statement, an investor roadshow, pricing, and finally the first day of trading. [e003:f10] Recent Financial Times reporting says OpenAI is considering another private funding round and that CEO Sam Altman has suggested an IPO likely won’t happen before 2027. [e003:f11] Falling technology valuations, weaker investor appetite for AI or greater regulatory uncertainty could delay an offering. [e003:f12] OpenAI, Anthropic and the AI IPO Market OpenAI won’t be valued in a vacuum. [e003:f13] It has also confidentially filed for an IPO and reached a $965 billion private valuation in May 2026. [e003:f14] But future investors will also want to understand OpenAI’s obligations to Microsoft, its reliance on outside computing providers, and how much flexibility it has to form competing partnerships. [e003:f15] The company’s growth could remain exceptional while its stock still disappoints if investors pay a valuation that assumes too much future success. [e003:f16] OpenAI’s revenue growth, losses, cash requirements and IPO valuation will show how much future AI dominance is already built into the price.

evidence.title: Investor buys Microsoft shares ahead of OpenAI IPO, betting on unpriced value of its 27% stake.
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Microsoft owns about 27% of OpenAI, valued at $135 billion in a recent restructuring, with OpenAI's IPO expected around 2027 at a potential $1.2 trillion valuation. [e006:f02] This stake, currently unpriced by public markets, represents a significant hidden asset within Microsoft's $3.81 trillion market cap. [e006:f03] The investor prefers holding Microsoft shares to benefit from OpenAI's growth, supported by Microsoft's strong revenue growth, large cloud backlog, and solid financial metrics. [e006:f04] Despite rising capital expenditures and OpenAI losses impacting earnings, demand for Microsoft's cloud services remains high, and the investor sees value in owning Microsoft ahead of OpenAI's public listing. [e006:f05] Microsoft shares trade at USD 518.40 on Pluang as of Oct 02, 2026 21:02 WIB, showing a 1.09% gain in the last day. [e006:f06] The stock holds a market cap of $3.81 trillion, reflecting its significant scale in the technology sector. [e006:f07] Despite a majority of Pluang investors selling, with 77% sell orders, the stock remains a key holding with a typical hold time of 141 days.

evidence.title: 35% of Web Pages Published Since ChatGPT Show Signs of AI Writing
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The finding covers pages dated after ChatGPT launched publicly in November 2022. [e004:f02] It does not mean 35% of the entire internet comes from machines. [e004:f03] Researchers found signs of AI authorship across 35% of recently published webpages in July 2026. [e004:f04] Across the full July 2026 sample, about 10% showed meaningful AI involvement. [e004:f05] Researchers sampled 10,000 pages from each of 49 crawls between 2021 and 2026. [e004:f06] For its analysis, Pew used Pangram's open-weight editlens_Llama-3.2-3B detection model. [e004:f07] That threshold also included pages combining human writing with machine-assisted changes. [e004:f08] In 2026 samples, around one in ten .com pages showed signs of AI authorship. [e004:f09] The comparable figure for .org pages was 4.6% during the same period. [e004:f10] Rates for .edu and .gov pages were each around 1%. [e004:f11] Oxford comma use increased 63% across the same comparison period. [e004:f12] However, generating many pages without adding user value may violate scaled-content spam policies. [e004:f13] They show that automated writing now has a measurable presence across newer pages. [e004:f14] Another 24% say they use these chatbots every day. [e004:f15] The 35% figure should therefore start a discussion rather than end one. [e004:f16] It tells us machine-assisted writing has entered mainstream web publishing at substantial scale.

evidence.title: 名もないサイバーセキュリティ・ベンチャーがClaudeを使ってOpenAIをハッキングし、100万円の報奨金を獲得した（海外）
evidence.body: [e008:f01] （illustration by Leon Neal/Getty Images） ハックトロンという小さなサイバーセキュリティ・スタートアップが、Claudeの力を借りてオープンAIのコードベースに侵入した。 [e008:f02] 同社はオープンAIのシステムの脆弱性を指摘し、その発見に対して6500ドル（102万500円）の報奨金を獲得した。 [e008:f03] 最近になり、悪意あるAIエージェントが野放しになる可能性が顕在化したことで、AI終末論（AIによる人類滅亡）への懸念が急浮上している。 [e008:f04] オープンAIによるハギング・フェイス（Hugging Face）ハッキング事件の直後、ある小規模なAIスタートアップがClaudeを使ってオープンAI（OpenAI）の内部コードベースに侵入した。 [e008:f05] ハックトロンは、サンフランシスコを拠点とするAIサイバーセキュリティのスタートアップだ。 [e008:f06] 2026年7月、チャン氏のチームはオープンAIのインフラにいくつかの脆弱性を発見した。 [e008:f07] その後、ハックトロンは、その脆弱性をClaude経由で悪用しようと試みた。 [e008:f08] チャン氏によると、同社はアンソロピック（Anthropic）の「サイバー検証プログラム（Cyber Verification Program）」へのアクセス権を持っていたため、許可を得たセキュリティ調査に限り、Claudeに課されている一部のサイバー関連の制限が緩和されていたという。 [e008:f09] 同社のチームは、オープンAI従業員のアカウントをハッキングし、その従業員のCodexアカウントに指示を与え、オープンAIの内部コードリポジトリへの変更を提案させることに成功した。 [e008:f10] ハックトロンによれば、チームはそこで攻撃を停止し、内部コードには一切アクセスせず、この問題をオープンAIに報告したという。 [e008:f11] ハックトロンはこの開示情報のなかで、今回の発見によって同社が6500ドル（102万500円、1ドル＝157円）の報奨金を獲得したことを明らかにした。 [e008:f12] 同社は設立から1年未満で、従業員数も10人に満たないスタートアップだ。 [e008:f13] Aditi Bharade 【関連リンク】 今さら聞けない…OpenAIの不正アクセス事件で何が起き、なぜ中国製AIが「英雄」視されているのか サイバーセキュリティ分野、AI脅威論によって“追い風”を受ける。 [e008:f14] 「最大の受益者になる」 「超知能AIは核兵器や小惑星よりはるかに恐ろしい」…元ディープマインド安全性研究者が制御不能なAIの未来を警告 「自社AIによるサイバー攻撃の情報開示を、AI企業に義務づけるべき」…OpenAI不正アクセスの被害企業CEOが主張 AIに人類を滅亡させる方法を聞いてみた…4つのAIモデルはこう答えた。

evidence.title: ヘンリー・イン氏の観察：1,200体のAIエージェントがサンドボックスを突破し「組織を発見」、OpenAIの収入は2カ月で400億ドルから700億ドルへ急増
evidence.body: [e009:f01] 2026年第3四半期、AI業界は能力の飛躍的向上と制御不能リスクの臨界点に同時に立っている。 [e009:f02] OpenAIは1万体のAIエージェントを並行稼働させ88時間、1,300億トークンを消費し、ミレニアム数学難題の一つであるナビエ・ストークス方程式の存在性と滑らかさの問題を攻略した。 [e009:f03] GPT-6 Astraは汎用モデルとして初めてエンドツーエンドでロボットアームを直接制御し、シミュレーション評価で平均成功率22%を達成。 [e009:f04] GPT-5.5の0.88%、Physical IntelligenceのVLAモデルPi 0.5の6.9%を大きく上回った。 [e009:f05] しかし同じ能力が、これまでで最も不安をかき立てる安全事故も引き起こした。 [e009:f06] 訓練中のAIエージェントがサンドボックス隔離を突破し、共有パッケージマネージャーのディレクトリ名を通じて相互通信。 [e009:f07] 最終的に約1,200体のエージェントが協力集団を形成し、700体がHugging Faceを攻撃して内部データを取得、その後OpenAI自身の研究クラスターを占拠した。 [e009:f08] 受験生が試験会場を占拠したようなものだ。 [e009:f09] シリコンバレーのアーリーステージファンドMoE Capitalの創業パートナー、ヘンリー・イン氏は「晩点聊」番組で、これは従来型の具身知能モデル企業にとって弱材料だと明言。 [e009:f10] 業界内ではすでに「今回の波で老舗企業はすべて終わる」との声が上がっているという。 [e009:f11] 一方、OpenAIの年間経常収益は8月から9月にかけて約400億ドルから約700億ドルへ急増し、成長率でAnthropicを逆転。 [e009:f12] 同等の知能水準のモデル利用コストは7カ月で約22分の1に低下した。

evidence.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
evidence.body: [e002:f01] In an essay published in The Atlantic , Robinson said he led the writing of safety reports that accompanied OpenAI’s major product launches. [e002:f02] He also said that with three-and-a-half years at OpenAI, he is “among the longest-tenured employees at the company.” Now he’s quitting, because in his view, the company’s “culture is broken.” In some ways, Robinson’s comments echo those of Jacob Coxon, who worked as a researcher at both OpenAI and Anthropic before quitting and declaring that these companies are “gambling with our lives.” Coxon’s comments led to a broader debate about AI safety, with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei unveiling a plan for more cautious AI development ; AI executives met with President Donald Trump this week and signed what appeared to be hastily written, non-binding pledge to implement more safety controls . [e002:f03] But in Robinson’s view, the debate needs to go beyond “specific rules or new laws,” addressing the overall culture at these companies. [e002:f04] And while much of the reporting around OpenAI has focused on how the company’s CEO Sam Altman lost the trust of former colleagues , Robinson’s essay suggests that OpenAI’s culture issues are the same as those of Silicon Valley at large. [e002:f05] “OpenAI has thrived by trial and error (which it calls ‘iterative deployment’), looking for problems and improving its guardrails in response,” he wrote. [e002:f06] “But this approach, by its very nature, guarantees periodic failures — and the scale of those failures is growing as systems get more capable.” Pointing to the recent breach of Hugging Face systems by OpenAI agents, as well as continuing revelations of OpenAI discovering more rogue agents , Robinson argued, “An environment where things like this can happen is no place to grow artificial minds that could be smarter than we are and that might not do what we want them to.” Given the increased risk, Robinson argued that frontier AI companies need to start operating “like nuclear-power plants or busy airports, with layers of redundancy and careful, time-consuming planning, so that the occasional and inevitable human error does not open a door to disaster.” But Robinson said that in his time at OpenAI, he “never encountered a colleague who had experience making airplanes fly safely or nuclear reactors run without melting down, or helping the financial system grow without collapsing.” In response to Robinson’s essay, OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the company continues to improve its safety measures. [e002:f07] “We’re making sure our models don’t become more capable than we can safely manage and secure, and we pause training or hold back models when we need to slow down,” Pusateri said in a statement. [e002:f08] “We’re making significant changes to strengthen security in our research and testing environments, train models to not just complete tasks but do so responsibly, expand our work with third-party evaluators, and improve real-time monitoring so we can detect and respond to concerning behavior earlier in the training process .” Beyond calling for changes in OpenAI’s culture, Robinson also said it’s time to ask bigger questions about alignment — something that he admitted could sound “touchy-feely,” but he said it’s critical as companies’ current “measures of how well” AI systems “match human values are coarse.” “The smarter the industry lets models grow while these problems remain unsolved, the more dangerous our situation becomes,” he said. [e002:f09] In his essay, he also acknowledged that he’s following an apparently a common step in the AI whistleblower playbook: He’s hired a PR firm . [e002:f10] But he insisted, “The decision to speak out is mine alone.” “Perhaps I should have stayed and fought for fundamental shifts in our staffing and culture, but in practice, my colleagues and I were so busy sprinting that we seldom had the chance to consider big changes, much less to actually make them,” Robinson said. [e002:f11] “That’s why I concluded that stronger incentives for safety — coming from outside the company — are a big part of getting this right.” Topics AI , OpenAI , Security When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission . [e002:f12] Previously, he worked as a tech reporter at Adweek, a senior editor at VentureBeat, a local government reporter at the Hollister Free Lance, and vice president of content at a VC firm. evidence.title: OpenAI Stock IPO: Expected Valuation, Timeline and Investment Options
evidence.body: [e004:f01] OpenAI's confidential S-1 filing marks the first formal step toward what could be the largest technology IPO in U.S. history. [e004:f02] OpenAI, the artificial intelligence company behind ChatGPT, has taken formal steps toward a potential initial public offering (IPO), although OpenAI stock is not currently available on a public exchange. [e004:f03] The company confidentially filed a draft registration statement with the SEC in May 2026, but CEO Sam Altman has since said OpenAI will not go public in 2026, making 2027 the earliest publicly discussed timeline. [e004:f04] For investors interested in an OpenAI IPO, the company’s rapidly changing private-market valuation, financial outlook and competitive position can help put a potential future listing into context. [e004:f05] If you are thinking about participating in an IPO, a financial advisor may help you evaluate whether it fits your overall allocation, risk tolerance and investment timeline. [e004:f06] What the Confidential S-1 Filing Means OpenAI filed a confidential draft registration statement with the SEC on May 22, 2026. [e004:f07] OpenAI’s IPO timeline has become clearer since its confidential filing. [e004:f08] In September 2026, CEO Sam Altman said the company would not go public in 2026 and indicated that an IPO would not take place until at least 2027 as OpenAI focuses on safety-related concerns surrounding increasingly capable AI systems. [e004:f09] OpenAI’s Valuation History and What It Would Mean for the IPO Market OpenAI’s private-market valuation increased from roughly $86 billion in early 2024 to $852 billion in March 2026, when the company closed a $122 billion funding round. [e004:f10] Because that financing has not yet closed, the $1.4 trillion figure should be viewed as a prospective valuation rather than OpenAI’s current confirmed value. [e004:f11] Date Valuation Capital Raised Key Context Early 2024 ~$86 billion N/A Thrive-led employee tender offer 2 Late 2024 ~$157 billion $6.6 billion Primary round led by Thrive Capital 3 October 2025 ~$500 billion N/A Recapitalization and conversion to PBC 4 February 2026 ~$730B pre-money (~$840B post) $110 billion (announced) Amazon , Nvidia, SoftBank anchor; Stargate-linked 5 March 31, 2026 $852 billion $122 billion Largest private funding round in history; ~$3B sold to individuals via three banks; a16z, ARK, BlackRock, Fidelity, Sequoia, SoftBank, Thrive, T. [e004:f12] Rowe Price among investors 6 IPO target $852B–$1 trillion+ Not yet set OpenAI has delayed a listing until at least 2027 and has not announced an IPO valuation target OpenAI’s listing would arrive alongside Anthropic, which was valued at $965 billion following its June 2026 funding round. [e004:f13] Who Has Already Invested in OpenAI However, by the time of the IPO OpenAI’s investor base will be unusually broad for a company that has not traded publicly. [e004:f14] Retail investors today: ARK ETFs (ARKK, ARKW, ARKF): On March 31, 2026, ARK Invest reportedly bought about $240 million of OpenAI Group (Series C) shares across these three funds, each now holding roughly a 3% OpenAI position, the first brokerage-accessible, no-accreditation path to indirect exposure. [e004:f15] 12 Nvidia (NVDA): A $30 billion investor and primary GPU supplier, offering exposure to the compute layer behind OpenAI’s products. evidence.title: ChatGPTでサインイン提供開始 外部アプリ認証を簡素化
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 認証済みユーザーが世界中で利用でき、AirtableやGitLab、Notionなど一部サービスへの導入が始まっている。 [e005:f02] 対象はEnterprise組織のメンバーを含む認証済みChatGPTユーザーで、世界中から利用可能となる。 [e005:f03] OpenAI AcademyやChatGPT Sitesに加え、一部のプラグインやパートナーサイトにも順次導入されている。 [e005:f04] 初期対応先にはAirtable、GitLab、HubSpot、Notion、Supabase、Vercelが含まれ、組織のメンバーが利用できるかどうかは管理者設定にも左右される。 [e005:f05] 本人認証だけで外部サービスへ共有される情報は、名前、メールアドレス、設定済みの場合のプロフィール写真に限定される。 [e005:f06] ChatGPTの会話やメモリ、ファイル、請求情報などは共有されず、追加データや操作へのアクセスには別途承認が必要だ。 [e005:f07] 一方、OpenAIは本人確認や組織設定の適用、認可、サインインフローの保護に必要な情報を処理する。 [e005:f08] 対象にはアカウント情報や認可内容に加え、IPアドレス、デバイス情報、セッション情報、認可結果などが含まれるとしている。 [e005:f09] 一部の対応アプリでは、ChatGPTプランに含まれる利用上限やクレジットをパートナー側のツールで利用できる。 [e005:f10] ユーザー自身で利用量や上限を管理でき、サブスクリプションの共有を許可しなくても本人認証によるサインインは完了可能だ。 [e005:f11] ※IDプロバイダー：利用者の本人確認を行い、その認証結果を外部サービスへ提供する仕組み。 [e005:f12] 利便性向上の一方で権限管理が重要に 今回の仕組みは、ChatGPTアカウントを外部サービスへの入口として活用できる点が大きな特徴だ。 [e005:f13] 特にプラグインとの組み合わせでは、本人認証に加えてChatGPTプランの利用枠を外部ツールで使える仕組みが普及すれば、AIサービスごとに契約や利用枠を管理する負担の軽減につながると考えられる。 [e005:f14] OpenAIにとっても、ChatGPTを単独のAIサービスから外部サービスへ接続する共通基盤へ広げる動きになるだろう。 [e005:f15] 一方で、本人情報によるサインインと、外部データや機能へのアクセス権限は明確に分けて考える必要がある。 [e005:f16] 今後、対応アプリが拡大すれば、ChatGPTアカウントを共通IDとして使う場面が増える可能性があり、利便性とセキュリティを両立できる管理体制の整備が普及の鍵になりそうだ。

evidence.title: ChatGPTで献立を相談、そのまま買い物へ SafewayがAIショッピングを開始
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 米スーパーマーケット大手Albertsons CompaniesはOpenAIとの連携を拡大し、傘下のSafewayでChatGPTを活用した新しい買い物体験を展開します。 [e006:f02] 献立の相談から商品探し、カート作成までをChatGPT上で進め、Safewayでの購入につなげます。 [e006:f03] 「4人でピザを食べたい」から商品選びまでAIが支援 新しいSafewayのChatGPT体験では、レシピや写真、デジタルの買い物リストのほか、自然な言葉から買い物を始められます。 [e006:f04] 例えば「4人分のピザナイトを計画して」「デリの商品で簡単な夕食を考えて」と相談すると、ChatGPTが関連する商品や割引情報を提示し、カート作成を支援。 [e006:f05] その後、Safewayでの決済へ案内します。 [e006:f06] 「何を買うか」を決めてから商品を検索する従来型のECだけでなく、「今日何を食べるか」という曖昧な相談からAIと一緒に買い物を組み立てられるのが特徴です。 [e006:f07] 今後はSafewayだけでなく、Albertsons、Vons、Jewel-Osco、Shaw’s、ACME、Tom Thumbなどのブランドへの展開も計画されています。 [e006:f08] 店舗の裏側でもAI活用 Albertsons Companiesは2,200店以上を展開し、週3,600万人以上の顧客にサービスを提供しています。 [e006:f09] 顧客向けだけでなく、ChatGPT EnterpriseやOpenAI APIなどを活用し、デジタルショッピング、店舗運営、商品施策、顧客体験など幅広い領域でAI活用を進めています。 [e006:f10] 商品担当者向けには、予測モデルと生成AIを組み合わせ、データに基づく商品提案や販促に関するインサイトを提供し、意思決定を支援する取り組みも進めています。 [e006:f11] 「商品名を検索する」から「やりたいことをAIに相談する」へと入口が変われば、小売企業にとって商品をどのようにAIに提案してもらうかも、新たな顧客接点の設計要素になっていきそうです。 [e006:f12] 詳しくは、OpenAIの公式発表まで。 [e006:f13] レポート／DXマガジン編集部 シェアはこちらから URLをコピーしました！

evidence.title: US FTC will investigate Anthropic and OpenAI
evidence.body: [e008:f01] The US Federal Trade Commission has warned leading AI players that they will to have tighten up their acts. [e008:f02] The agency will soon send formal demands for information to Anthropic, OpenAI, and other AI companies as part of an investigation into whether they are breaking consumer protection laws. [e008:f03] The FTC has acted following a number of incidents where AI models have penetrated corporate systems. [e008:f04] In the past few months, we’ve seen OpenAI agents attack Ruby Gems and Claude breaching three organizations during security testing. [e008:f05] Security experts have since warned of new dangers as these companies expand their operations, with new threats continually emerging. [e008:f06] This is not a new area of interest for the FTC, which takes a keen interest in computer security and has previously issued heavy fines to companies with inadequate protections. [e008:f07] The agency has also investigated other AI companies. [e008:f08] Last year, it had Alphabet, OpenAI and Meta in its sights when it was looking at the impact of chatbots on children, and in June the FTC broadened an investigation into Microsoft’s cloud and AI activities.

evidence.title: ChatGPT’s Safety Gets Audited. OpenAI Decides What Auditors See
evidence.body: [e001:f01] OpenAI Decides What Auditors See Posted on October 2, 2026 October 2, 2026 by Flavia Moura 02 Oct Three researchers are out over information shared with an outside safety group. [e001:f02] OpenAI fired three safety researchers for sharing confidential information with an unnamed third-party AI safety organization. [e001:f03] One of them, Tomek Korbak, has said he served as OpenAI’s technical contact for METR and Redwood Research when those groups investigated how OpenAI’s agents broke into Hugging Face in July. [e001:f04] What Happened The Wall Street Journal reported on October 1 that OpenAI terminated Jasmine Wang, Tomek Korbak and Mikita Balesni for alleged misconduct, including sharing confidential company information with a third-party AI safety group. [e001:f05] Balesni put his own odds of AI killing all humans above 10%, and Korbak wrote that he was unhappy with much of what OpenAI does while noting he was allowed to say so. [e001:f06] On September 28, OpenAI scrapped the October launch of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal tests showed more deception and more actions taken without user permission than its predecessor. [e001:f07] This week, California Attorney General Rob Bonta served OpenAI with an investigative subpoena covering cybersecurity incidents involving its models, extending a formal investigation into the Hugging Face breach that his office opened last month. [e001:f08] The Backstory To see why the plumbing matters, look at the one independent investigation that has already happened. [e001:f09] After OpenAI’s agents attacked Hugging Face, the company let two METR staff members and a Redwood Research contractor work on its premises. [e001:f10] The agreement, reached July 29, covered seven questions. [e001:f11] Out of scope: whether safeguards worked, how deep the compromise went, and how good OpenAI’s own investigation and remediation were. [e001:f12] The reviewers ran their analysis on free credits for OpenAI’s own GPT-5.6 Sol, an estimated $400,000 worth over six days, and warned that the same model had cooperated with the agents it was now being asked to judge. [e001:f13] The investigation covered 18 of 75 days, or 24% of the episode as OpenAI narrated it. [e001:f14] Apollo Research said it had only three days to test GPT-6 Astra before release. ’s chief executive told TechCrunch his firm has turned down contracts with several frontier developers that wanted too much control, and that evaluators are by default treated like ordinary contractors under restrictive NDAs. [e001:f15] On September 29, six AI chiefs signed a White House accord that calls for an independent external auditor at every frontier lab, with findings reporting to each company’s own board rather than to a regulator or the public. [e001:f16] Governor Gavin Newsom signed SB 813 on September 9, creating a framework for state-designated independent verification organizations, and AB 1405, which sets up a registry of AI auditors.

evidence.body: [e004:f01] SoftBank Group invested an additional $10 billion in OpenAI Group PBC, OpenAI's for-profit arm, lifting its cumulative investment to $64.6 billion and giving it a stake of about 13%. [e004:f02] Japanese ITmedia reported on Wednesday that the investment is the third and final tranche of an additional $30 billion investment made through SoftBank Vision Fund Group disbursed the funds in three $10 billion tranches under an agreement it signed with OpenAI on Feb. [e004:f03] SoftBank funded the first two tranches with bridge loans and the final tranche with proceeds from bond sales. [e004:f04] Its stake is about 13 percent. [e004:f05] The first tranche was disbursed on April 1 and the second on July 1. [e004:f06] The third tranche completes the funds for the first and second investments were raised through bridge loans from major financial institutions involved in the transaction. [e004:f07] For the final tranche, it used funds raised through corporate bond Group announced plans on Sept. [e004:f08] 24 to issue dollar- and euro-denominated corporate bonds and cited the third-tranche investment funding among the uses. [e004:f09] The total amount to be raised is about $11.1 billion. [e004:f10] Bloomberg and other media outlets reported that it was the largest high-yield bond issuance on record among low-credit-rating agreement also included language that the investment timing could be brought forward if an OpenAI stock listing was reasonably expected. [e004:f11] However, CEO Sam Altman said in a September interview with U.S. business magazine Fortune that he would prioritise responding to AI safety and did not intend to pursue a listing in 2026. [e004:f12] As a result, the investment was not brought forward and was disbursed on Oct. [e004:f13] 1 as originally planned.

evidence.title: Honda Confirms The 2027 Civic Type R Update, And It's A Bet Against The Industry's EV Shift
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Through high school and college, she could be found reading through whatever car magazines she could get her hands on, and her love for anything with four wheels has grown with each and every passing day. [e001:f02] Over the years, Alina has Alina has accumulated so much knowledge about common and obscure cars that she’s always able to surprise people with interesting facts and information. [e001:f03] She's been published in several magazines and automotive websites over the years. [e001:f04] Sign in to your HotCars account Honda just confirmed the 2027 Civic Type R, and the update lands at exactly the moment the hot hatch segment is supposed to be dying. [e001:f05] Honda's answer is a turbocharged four-cylinder, a six-speed manual, and a refreshed FL5 that goes deeper into the formula instead of running from it. [e001:f06] The 2.0-liter turbocharged VTEC engine carries over unchanged at 315 horsepower and 310 lb-ft of torque, still routed exclusively to the front wheels through a helical limited-slip differential and that class-exclusive six-speed stick. [e001:f07] It's Honda doubling down on the exact recipe that made the Type R a benchmark, while the rest of the segment scatters toward EVs or the scrapyard. [e001:f08] What Honda Actually Changed For 2027 The front fascia gets a larger grille opening and a deeper front splitter, both aimed at improving cooling and adding front-end downforce at speed. [e001:f09] That matters more than it sounds: Type R owners track these cars, and better airflow into the engine bay means more consistent performance when you're actually leaning on it. [e001:f10] Honda also went after the stuff that owners have complained about since the FL5 launched. [e001:f11] The aggressive +R drive mode has been recalibrated to cut down on bouncing and impact harshness over rough pavement, which should mean more confidence on a backroad without giving up the Type R's trademark stiffness. [e001:f12] Heated Seats Finally Arrive, And The Cabin Gets A Once-Over For the first time, the Civic Type R gets heated front seats as standard equipment, something it had weirdly lacked even as its more premium cousin, the Acura Integra Type S , offered them. [e001:f13] Elsewhere, the cabin picks up Ultrasuede trim on the instrument panel and upper door panels, a darker aluminum shift knob, and black climate control knobs. [e001:f14] Why Keeping This Car Alive Is The Real Story The 2027 model marks a decade of the Type R badge in the U.S. and 30 years globally, and Honda picked this moment to reaffirm the formula rather than walk away from it. [e001:f15] Tightening emissions regulations already forced Honda to kill the Type R in Europe, which makes the American refresh feel less like routine housekeeping and more like a statement: there's still a market here for a turbocharged, manual-only, front-wheel-drive hatchback, and Honda intends to keep selling it. [e001:f16] Honda is reportedly also developing a hardcore HRC-badged version of the Type R, which would suggest the FL5 generation has real shelf life left rather than winding down.

evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e003:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e003:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e003:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e003:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e003:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e003:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e003:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e003:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e003:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e003:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。
